name: TraderSpy
tagline: Crypto AI signals and whale positions for your agent
description:
Live crypto futures data for Cline: AI-generated trading signals with entry, target and stop levels plus their realised outcome; whale and elite-trader positioning across Binance, Hyperliquid, Bybit and OKX; prices, candles and 19 technical indicators over up to three timeframes in one call; funding rate and open interest; a market-wide condition screener and an event-study backtest.

All 17 tools are read-only — the server cannot place, close or modify an order and exposes no withdrawal or transfer tool.

env.name: TRADERSPY_API_KEY
env.description: Personal TraderSpy MCP key, starts with mcp_. Generate one for free at https://traderspy.app/mcp

install.notes: Sign in at https://traderspy.app/mcp to generate a key — it is shown once and can be revoked at any time. Free accounts get 300 tool calls per day, premium 5,000.
